recognize_zh: 周邊血三顆中型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質豐富淡藍並含小空泡，細胞核卵圓、腎形或雙葉凹陷，染色質中度濃縮；比一般淋巴球細胞質多、核型不規則，符合毛細胞白血病變異型（HCL-v）的循環細胞，但此圖核仁不明顯、毛狀突起也不突出。
features: Three intermediate-sized lymphoid cells, larger than small lymphocytes
Moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm with small cytoplasmic vacuoles
Oval to reniform or bilobed/indented nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not conspicuous at this resolution
Cytoplasmic borders mostly smooth with only subtle irregularity; well-developed hairy projections are not evident
Background red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional fragments
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three atypical intermediate-sized lymphoid cells in a background of red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis. The cells have moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm with small vacuoles and oval, reniform or bilobed nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin. Distinct nucleoli and well-formed circumferential hairy projections are not evident in this image. The findings are compatible with circulating cells of splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli (formerly hairy cell leukemia variant) in context, but are not specific; flow cytometry (CD11c+, CD103+/-, CD25-, CD123-) and BRAF V600E status are needed to separate it from classic hairy cell leukemia and other splenic lymphomas.

ddx.vs: Classic HCL cells are CD25+, CD123+, annexin A1+ and BRAF V600E-mutated, and classic HCL presents with monocytopenia rather than leukocytosis.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have short polar villi and are CD11c variable, CD103-negative.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin, grey-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules, and express CD14 rather than B-cell markers.
Prolymphocytes have a single prominent central nucleolus and less abundant cytoplasm.
